# Breakaway

> AI agents, process automation, and CRM/ERP/WhatsApp integrations for professional services firms in Mexico.

Breakaway (https://breakaway.work) helps professional services firms in Mexico connect their operational tools, automate repetitive workflows, and deploy production AI agents. Services are delivered in Spanish and English.

- AI Agents: https://breakaway.work/es/services/ai-agents | https://breakaway.work/en/services/ai-agents
- Process Automations: https://breakaway.work/es/services/automations | https://breakaway.work/en/services/automations
- Integrations (CRM, ERP, WhatsApp): https://breakaway.work/es/services/integrations | https://breakaway.work/en/services/integrations
- Web Pages: https://breakaway.work/es/services/web-pages | https://breakaway.work/en/services/web-pages
- Apps: https://breakaway.work/es/services/apps | https://breakaway.work/en/services/apps
